nodes.name: Dedupe by Call ID
nodes.notes: Stops the same call event being processed twice. Uses n8n's workflow static data (persists between executions) to remember call IDs already handled.

nodes.name: If - Opt-out phrase detected
nodes.notes: Broadened from a single-phrase match to several common opt-out phrases (OR). Still a keyword match, not true intent detection - the report and interview note this as the known limitation and the next step (Vapi structured analysis output or a small classification prompt).

nodes.name: webhook
nodes.notes: Authentication set to Header Auth. Create a credential in n8n with header name 'x-vapi-secret' and a value matching the secret set on the Vapi assistant's server config. Vapi sends this header on every request; a mismatched or missing header is now rejected by n8n before the workflow runs.

nodes.name: Add Interested Tag to GHL
nodes.notes: Now pulls the caller's real name/email/phone/callId from the Vapi payload instead of a hard-coded contact. On a web test call these fields are often empty, so it falls back to 'Unknown caller (see callId)' rather than a real person's name. leadId is read from call metadata - set this when the outbound call is launched from GHL so the report can match the call back to L01-L05.
